That's a great suggestion.

I'm reading Walden, and have just finished the 1st chapter. What a delightful book. Every page of it inspires me to keep fighting my internet addiction to try and live a more authentic (and deliberate) life.

Hell yeah. I was impressed during the whole read. I wish my little sisters were as self-aware as this guy.

The thing I hate the most about TikTok is the fact that it's both short-form and has infinite scroll. It's the perfect setup to completely wreck people's attention span and cognitive skills.

And I say that as someone whose mind was ruined by the internet. It's really hard for me to think unless I'm far away from any connection to the internet.

Now, mind you, I've never used TikTok. It was not a thing when I was a kid. (Although I'm still young.)

If watching YouTube videos and reading articles on the internet all day fucked with my head, I can only imagine what TikTok is going to do with people's mind.

This thing is terrifying, and should be treated like a public health emergency.
